# Atlas Migration — Project Plan

## Scope

Migrate legacy CRM customer records to the new platform via a batch ETL process.
Scope explicitly excludes real-time sync between the legacy and new systems; that
was evaluated and deferred during initial scoping.

## Milestones

- Milestone: M1 Data model mapping — Owner: Priya — Due: 2026-06-15
- Milestone: M2 ETL pipeline built — Owner: Dev Team — Due: 2026-06-30
- Milestone: M3 UAT — Owner: QA Team — Due: 2026-07-15
- Milestone: M4 Go-live — Owner: Priya — Due: 2026-07-31
